entries.name: transaction-plus-on-bool-collections-accept#0
entries.description: A transaction output whose tree is BoolToSigmaProp(EQ(Plus(C, C), C)), C = Coll[Boolean](true) (85 01 01). Only the nine relations read an 85 after their opcode as a packed Boolean pair; for Plus it is the start of a Boolean collection constant. The builder does not check an arithmetic operation's operand types at parse, so the tree parses. Round-trip identity. An impl that reads the pair form here consumes different bytes.
